purpose: Authoritative-source-backed game-content provenance registry foundation. This layer separates release/update evidence from research timestamps and does not rewrite canonical skill records unless an individual skill is directly tied to the cited release evidence.
rules: A research date is not a game-version date.
A DLC/update announcement establishes content availability/provenance, not balance changes unless the source explicitly documents a change.
A skill is not assigned to a release event merely because its DLC label resembles the event; direct content linkage is required.

research_gaps.claim: Official Bandai Namco release notice confirms a free update shipped alongside the DAIMA Pack and included Skills, but the canonical skills database currently contains no skill record explicitly labeled with that free update or otherwise explicitly tied to the May 2025 free-update skill subset.
research_gaps.action: Do not assign unidentified canonical skills to the free update by name, date, or proximity. Resolve only with direct skill-level evidence from authoritative/independent catalog sources.
